title: Origins: Vampire CONTINUED
description: A continuation of the original by Venekiel.
body:
# Origins-Vampire

**Required dependency: [Woodwalkers mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/woodwalkers)**

Original mod by Venekiel!

Origins: Vampire brings 2 new origins to the game :
- Vampire
- Vampire Lord

Only the Vampire origin is selectable when choosing your origin. You'll need to drink the blood dropped by the Ender Dragon to evolve into a Vampire Lord.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/i35rWw4szM8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Vampire

### Undead: 
Vampires are undead creatures that suck the blood of the living to fulfill their thirst.
Their undead condition makes them immune to poison and freezing damage, but weak to fire, and sunlight. They also have no need for oxygen.

### Unholy:
They are weak to wooden tools, as such, being hit by one will incapacitate you for a brief amount of time.

### Diet:
A Vampire's diet is limited to blood. They may suck it straight from the living or bottle it to drink later. Not every creature has the same type of blood!
Once their thirst is satisfied, Vampires are stronger and faster than humans, and can see clearly in the dark.

### Healing:
Vampires heal faster but it makes them thirsty quickly.
Their weakness to fire and sunlight prevents them from healing while exposed.

### Bat form:
Vampires can transform into bats to move discreetly and prevent the sunlight from affecting them.
On the other hand this form is more fragile, and does not have hands, preventing them from using their tools.

## Vampire Lord
They inherit their characteristics from their previous form, with extras.

### Winged:
Vampire Lords have wings strong enough to propel them forward while flying.

### Hunter's instinct:
Vampire Lords gain the ability to detect the living around them and tell friend from foe.
